ana_ml: FYI starting onboarding for tactile-13b (open, 13B) — want a prioritized perf intake and quick smoke before full eval.
miguel: +1. What's the target workload? chat? single-turn gen?
sophie: main ask is chat + longform summarization (we expect longer ctx). Also want embedding parity for similarity pipelines.
ana_ml: priority: 1) latency smoke (single request p50/p95), 2) throughput/batching profile, 3) ctx length sweep (2k/4k/8k/16k) for KV cache perf, 4) int4 quant smoke + quality regression on eval set.
ryan: can we aim for p95 < 220ms @ batch=1 on T4-equivalent? If not, fallback to Q4_0.
bench-bot: started bench job 1834056890 for tactile-13b on dev-pool-3
miguel: quick command I used:
```
bench run --model tactile-13b --quant none --batch 1 --seq 2048 --warmup 50 --iters 200 --out perf/tactile/smoke
```

sophie: when you have throughput numbers, add per-token cost estimate and token/sec at batch sizes 1/4/8/16.
ana_ml: also add a regression check: run eval suite (regset v2.1) and include failure diffs. If >1% perplexity delta or >3% ROUGE drop, flag.
ryan: noted. For int4 try `--quant int4-fxp` and compare. Include samples for human review.
miguel: initial smoke: p50=95ms p95=240ms (batch1, seq2k) — p95 slightly high. Throughput @batch4=120 tok/s. Logs: https://internal.logs/tactile/1834056890
sophie: if p95 is 240ms we need to test Q4 fallback and kernel tunning. Also run ctx sweep for 8k inc to see KV cache breakpoints.
ana_ml: checklist for full bring-up (short):
- smoke latency (batch1)
- batch profile (1/4/8/16) with tokens/sec
- ctx length sweep (2k/4k/8k/16k) measure token/sec and mem
- int4 smoke + decode quality check
- eval regset run + human samples
- perf/flaky test for 12h load
- add model entry to catalog with perf profile + recommended quant

miguel: assigning tasks: latency/throughput bench — miguel; quant smoke + eval — sophie; ctx sweep + mem — ryan; catalog writeup — ana_ml
bench-bot: job complete: 1834056890 — artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/tactile/1834056890 (perf.csv, logs.tar.gz)
ana_ml: thanks — I'll triage artifacts and open a PR with the catalog entry draft. Tag me with any failing evals :eyes: 
sophie: quick note: use `--streaming=false` for latency smoke to measure end-to-end non-streamed p95.
miguel: thumbs: :thumbsup: Ok ramping up.
ana_ml: let's sync in tomorrow 10am to review numbers and decide go/no-go for dedicated onboarding.
ops-bot: meeting created: eng-ml/tactile-onboard-review @ 2028-11-02T10:00:00Z
ryan: perfect, will have ctx sweep artifacts by then.
